# Retrospective

## What went well
::: {.notes}
Process was smooth.
Reporting is quite straightforward.
Lots of delivered improvements to the Apache Arrow project maintenance and overall quality.
:::

## Mistakes and shortcomings
::: {.notes}
Maintenance is ongoing and requires continuous attention which is still underfunded.
Lots of things have changed since 1.5 years ago (AI rise) with both the landscape of funding
and the priorities within the Apache Arrow project.
Some work packages were over-specified: "Improve fuzzing" should have been
"Improve software quality and security" to encompass more varied tasks.
:::

## What's still left
::: {.notes}
Ongoing maintenance tasks.
Future improvements planned.
:::
